svg.title: Two histories between the same events
svg.desc: A home clock follows a vertical worldline for ten years. A traveller reaches three light-years in five years and returns in another five. The idealized travelling clock accumulates 10√(1 − 0.6²) = 8 years. The sharp turnaround is an approximation; the path integral, not a local feeling of slow time, gives the age difference.

g.text: 06 / TWO HISTORIES BETWEEN THE SAME EVENTS
